speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing gait and limb ataxia, and you have a significant medical history. To begin our evaluation, how long have you been experiencing these balance and coordination issues?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds quite concerning. The "drunken" appearance of your gait suggests significant ataxia. Have these symptoms been getting worse over time, or did they start suddenly?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with and without contrast.
REQUEST TEST: JC Virus PCR analysis of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
